_note: This file is a declarative MMDetection configuration file for the DINO object detector. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only dictionary-based configuration for model architecture, training pipeline, optimizer, and scheduler settings. No tool-use examples are applicable.
review_DINO_model_config: review the DINO model configuration dict with ResNet50 backbone and 900 queries for COCO detection
review_train_pipeline: review the train_pipeline with multi-scale RandomChoiceResize and RandomCrop augmentations for object detection
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with gradient clipping and backbone learning rate multiplier
review_HungarianAssigner: review the HungarianAssigner match costs using FocalLossCost, BBoxL1Cost, and IoUCost for bipartite matching
review_param_scheduler: review the MultiStepLR parameter scheduler with milestone at epoch 11 and gamma 0.1
